_source: ENSv2 on Sepolia, from https://docs.ens.domains/learn/deployments section 'Sepolia (ENSv2)' (fetched 2026-11-06), cross-checked with ensdomains/ensjs@495ffc731a5f37b2e2c5504ac8959e75dae1da10 packages/ensjs/src/clients/chain.ts (sepolia block) and with fluidkey/stealth-ens-resolver test/fork/SepoliaENSv2.fork.t.sol. This is the redeploy of 2026-10-01 (ensdomains/namechain tag v2-mainnet-deployment-1, commit 62778d8). Addresses change between ENS redeploys: re-check this file against the docs before every live run. This is the ONLY place ENS addresses live; scripts, the gateway (via env) and the e2e read them from here. The batch gateway provider is not listed in the docs: scripts read it on-chain from UniversalResolverV2.BATCH_GATEWAY_PROVIDER().
